name: Lake Champlain Maritime Museum Day Camps
description_short: Week-long summer day camps for ages 6–16 run by a museum on Lake Champlain. Each camp is grouped by age and has one theme, such as fishing, watershed ecology, snorkeling, metalsmithing, boating, or building a kayak over three weeks. All tuition is pay-what-you-can.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel 14 or more days before the first day of the session for a full refund of the amount paid. After that, you may not get a full refund. Full Camp Participation Policies are on a separate page.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camps take place on and around Lake Champlain. They include snorkeling (Watershed Ecology and Underwater Exploration), swimming in the lake, and canoeing, kayaking, sailing and rowing in the Museum's fleet of boats. The page says staff are trained in CPR/First Aid but does not mention lifeguard certification or swim tests.
